title: Ila Sachani: Embroidering Dreams with her Feet
subject: English
summary: “Ila Sachani: Embroidering Dreams with her Feet” is an inspiring story about a woman named Ila Sachani from Gujarat. She was born with a disability that made it difficult for her to use her hands. However, she did not lose hope and learned to do embroidery using her feet. With hard work, patience and determination, she became an expert in different types of embroidery. Her beautiful embroidery work became popular, and she received many awards and recognition. Her story teaches us that physical challenges cannot stop a person who has courage and determination. The chapter teaches us that hard work, confidence and strong determination can help us achieve our dreams.
